public final class AIcNameConventionCatalog extends Object implements eu.algites.lib.naming.convention.AIiNameConventionCatalog

    • loadAll

      public static AIcNameConventionCatalog loadAll(List<String> aSources) throws IOException
      Combines external and classpath-packaged naming catalogs into a single lookup.

      Repeated identical definitions are intentionally deduplicated; conflicting definitions cannot override each other based on the order of source files. The resource: prefix selects a YAML resource packaged inside the naming-conventions artifact, independently of the current working directory.

      Parameters:
      aSources - catalog locations, in lookup order; at least one is required
      Returns:
      one resolved naming catalog covering all supplied definitions
      Throws:
      IOException - if a source cannot be read or is not valid YAML
      IllegalArgumentException - if identifiers have conflicting definitions

    • generatedMethodReference

      public String generatedMethodReference(String aRole)
      Retrieves the composition ID assigned to an optional generated method role. An absent or blank value explicitly disables that method and must not be replaced by a generator-specific default. The selected profile must exist.
      Parameters:
      aRole - generated method role, such as raw_getter
      Returns:
      the composition ID or null when the role is disabled or no generated-method profile is selected

      Returns:
